title: DevX Initiative Portfolio: Prioritization & Impact Canvas for SDKs, Docs, and Starter Kits
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: This ticket consolidates a single prioritization and tracking canvas for developer experience initiatives across SDKs, docs, and starter kits. Goal: move from a long unprioritized backlog to a measurable portfolio with clear OKRs, leading indicators, and a lightweight experiment plan. The approach applies an Impact Canvas that ranks initiatives by adoption delta, developer time-to-first-call reduction, and unit cost improvements (e.g., sample app token costs). Outcome: surface top 6 initiatives to fund in Q2 and create a two-week experimentation runway for the top 3.
acceptance_criteria: - Prioritization canvas completed and reviewed by Eng, Design, and Growth. - Top 6 initiatives selected with owners, hypotheses, and 2 success metrics each. - Telemetry dashboard (adoption delta + activation funnel) is linked and shows baseline values. - 2-week experiment plans for top 3 initiatives with success thresholds and rollback criteria approved.
comments: 2026-01-20: Kickoff workshop held with PM/Eng/Design. Collected 28 candidate initiatives across SDKs, docs, and starter kits.
2026-01-28: Raw scoring applied (value, confidence, effort). Need to normalize effort across infra vs content-led work. Action: Eng to provide typical effort bands for runtime/instrumentation work.
2026-02-09: Added adoption delta metric (MAU change from cohort exposed to initiative) and artifact cost savings to scoring. Design requested addition of qualitative developer sentiment measure.

2026-02-24: Stakeholder review: Growth pushed for prioritizing sample app templates that reduce onboarding friction; Security flagged packaging changes as requiring extra review for Private customers. Added dependency on ENG-2765 (packaging infra cleanup).
2026-03-03: Prototype experiment plan for 'starter-kit templates' drafted. Estimated 2 sprint eng lift + documentation refresh. Dashboard baseline captured (see links).
2026-03-10: Canvases updated post-feedback. Ready for cross-functional signoff in Q2 planning sync.
notes: Proposed scoring tweaks: apply a 1.5x multiplier for initiatives that unblock Dedicated/Private customers (higher revenue signal). Consider 'Runway Score' combining confidence and low-friction implementation. Risk: changes to packaging may require KMS/HSM review for Private customers and will extend lead time. Trade-offs logged: focusing on SDK ergonomics may drive faster visible adoption but content-led work (docs + sample apps) yields better long-tail retention.
last_action: Prepared signoff deck for 2026-03-15 roadmap sync; requested Eng estimate update for ENG-2765 by 2026-03-14.
